articles.title: GE Aerospace and United ink big engine order
articles.mainIdea: GE Aerospace and United ink big engine order
articles.summary: Journal-News, Hamilton, Ohio: GE Aerospace and United ink big engine order. Feb. 18—GE Aerospace, a big Southwestern Ohio employer, has inked a deal with one of the nation's biggest airlines. GE said United Airlines has selected 300 GEnx engines to power United's new Boeing 787 Dreamliners.
